Why go: an all-inclusive yacht day for a couple

Siam Seas Explorer is a 14 m sport cruiser with 900 hp, one cabin and room for up to six. Unlike most charters on Koh Samui, the price includes lunch, alcohol, a bottle of wine and park fees, and the boat usually collects you from your resort's beach. It is designed for couples and very small groups who want a fast, private and fully catered day.

What you'll do

The 2-hour sunset run goes to Koh Madsum off Samui's south coast with canapés and drinks. Half days go to Koh Phangan or Koh Madsum for swimming and snorkelling. Full days reach Ang Thong Marine Park from 16 December, with lunch on board and the Emerald Lake viewpoint, or Koh Tao for clear water and reefs.

Who it suits

  • Honeymooners and couples marking an anniversary or a proposal.
  • Small families or two couples who want everything included.
  • Guests at beachfront resorts who prefer to step on board from the sand.

Who should choose something else

  • Groups larger than 6.
  • Couples who want sails and a slower pace: the Independence sailing yacht.
  • Anyone watching the budget: a private speedboat covers the same islands for much less.

Good to know

  • Speed: a sport cruiser rides harder than a catamaran in waves; not recommended in pregnancy or with back problems.
  • Sea: October to December is the windiest period, and beach pickups depend on surf.
  • Ang Thong: closed from 1 November to 15 December.

Before you book

Tell us your resort, the occasion and any dietary needs. For three to six guests, message us on WhatsApp so we can add the extra-guest charges, including VAT and service, and send one all-in price.
